export default "Experience what it is like when companies invade your homeland for their profit and destroy your living environment in **Gaslit**.{.intro}\r\n\r\nFor the college project *Context III*, we were asked by organization Fossielvrij Nederland (part of 350.org) to develop a game that communicates the negative effects on communities and the environment caused by the extraction of liquified natural gas (LNG). After a few prototypes exploring different directions of game, like story-based or puzzle-based, we settled on the format we would develop into Gaslit: a city-builder-like strategy game with puzzle elements.\r\n\r\nWe developed this vertical slice with a team of multidisciplinary students, with multiple programmers, designers and artists. I was responsible for **implementing gameplay features**, **project architecture** \r\n";
